mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (user_id, `password`, name, email, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, NULL, #{name}, #{email}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), email = VALUES(email), created_at = CASE WHEN created_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(created_at) WHEN VALUES(created_at) IS NULL THEN created_at WHEN VALUES(created_at) < created_at THEN VALUES(created_at) ELSE created_at END
